analyst_view.overall: A relegation six-pointer: Coventry are 17th under Frank Lampard, two points above bottom side Palace, who have lost seven of ten, conceded a league-high 24 goals and sacked Pierre Sage during the break. It is Thomas Frank's first game in charge after less than a week of training, which the numbers can't see; at his first press conference he ruled out Sarr and Tomiyasu, Mateta serves the second game of a three-match ban (all counted), and Strand Larsen trained after an ankle problem but is expected to start on the bench behind Nketiah. Coventry's news is slightly better: Bobby Thomas, Onyeka and Yirenkyi are back in training, while Eccles (ankle), Wright and Amenda stay out and Mason-Clark is expected to miss out. Referee Darren England is slightly above average for cards (counted).

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals, already counting Mateta's ban and Palace's leaky recent defence and Coventry's good scoring run. A new manager's first game usually starts with a tighter shape, and Palace are expected to start Nketiah with Strand Larsen only on the bench after his ankle problem; so I keep a mild trim to about 2.7.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Frank's sides like set pieces and direct play, but one week of training won't change Palace's wing-back system much, and Coventry's home style is already in their figures, so I stay at about 8.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards, low for a game between 17th and 20th, already counting referee Darren England (4.2 a game). A nervous six-pointer, with Palace players trying to impress a new manager and Lampard asking his side for 'more aggression', usually brings a few more fouls, so a mild lean up to about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots, pushed up by how many shots Palace have been conceding lately. Frank's first job will be to stop that, and Palace's own volume may suffer with Nketiah rather than Mateta or Strand Larsen up front: about 26.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.0 shots on target. A more cautious first game under Frank and a Palace attack without Mateta, Sarr and probably a starting Strand Larsen trims it a little, to about 7.8.
